image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of a Roseate Spoonbill's head and neck. The image highlights the distinctive elongated, flat bill with a spatulate shape, textured greyish skin on the face, a bright red eye, and white plumage on the neck transitioning to vibrant pink feathers on the body. The background is dark and out of focus.
